agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/filters/reindent.py: ReindentFilter._process_function was recording self._last_func = tlist[1] (the Parenthesis/argument-list group) instead of tlist[0] (the function name Identifier). This value feeds `adjusted_offset = -len(self._last_func.value) - 1` in _process_identifierlist, used to align wrapped function-argument lines under the function name. Using the wrong token (the whole parenthesized arg list) produced incorrect, oversized offsets, breaking reindent formatting for long identifier/column lists containing function calls. Changed `self._last_func = tlist[1]` to `self._last_func = tlist[0]` to restore correct behavior. Verified via manual sqlparse.format(..., reindent=True[, wrap_after=N]) calls on SQL with function calls mixed into long column lists, confirming correct indentation, while plain long-identifier-list formatting (no functions) remains unaffected.
